text: Bitcoin's modest 3.4% gain alongside Ethereum's stronger 6.1% jump suggests money is rotating toward altcoins despite extreme fear conditions, with ETH outperforming the broader recovery. The Fear & Greed index at 19—though rising—indicates traders remain deeply cautious, yet the $96B in daily volume and Bitcoin's stable 55.8% dominance show the market has enough liquidity to move without panic selling. This combination hints at a potential bottoming phase where selective buyers are testing support while most participants remain sidelined.
